items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: Barney Josephson brought us back there to work Cafe Society.

ctx.x: Okay. So the band that we had was quite unique because they had not started using guitars playing parts, so we had 4 part harmony, and this was why Gerald and Dudley and Billy Strayon wanted to write for us, because we had -- which is a big sound; he used a trumpet, 2 tenors and guitar. And you voice that properly, and you have a big sound -- and we did have a big sound.
As a matter of fact, we made so much noise out here, they heard about it back east, and they brought -- Barney Josephson brought us back there to work Cafe Society.
Oh, did you ever record with this group?
